data.gender_notes: Nikoletta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Nike is the goddess of victory. The name Nikoletta is derived from the Greek word nikē, meaning victory, and the suffix -etta, which is a diminutive suffix. It can be interpreted as 'little victory'. The name Nikoletta carries the meaning “Victory of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nikoletta usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the power of victory in your spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Nikoletta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory of the people.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nikoletta total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_greek.name: Νικολέττα
in_greek.long_meaning: A form of Nikolaos (Nicolas), which is derived from the Greek words nike (victory) and theos (god). In Greek, it is written as Νικολέττα (Nikoletta) and is pronounced as /ni-koh-leh-ta/.

in_latin.name: Nicoletta
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latinized form of the Greek name Nikoletta. In Latin, it is written as Nicoletta and is pronounced as /ni-koh-leh-tah/.

in_english.name: Nikoletta
in_english.long_meaning: A variation of Nicole, derived from the Greek name Nike (Victory) and theos (God). In English, it is written as Nikoletta and is pronounced as /ni-koh-leh-tah/ or /ni-koh-leh-ta/.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nikoletta has historical roots in Greek mythology and Christianity. In Greek mythology, Nikē or Nike was the goddess of victory, often depicted as a winged figure wearing a helmet and holding a palm branch in one hand and a wreath in the other. However, although the name Nikoletta has Greek origins, it is most commonly used in Hungarian culture and is a popular name in Hungary.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nikoletta holds a strong spiritual significance as it is derived from the Greek word nikē, meaning victory. It imparts a sense of strength, courage, and determination. In Christianity, it can also be associated with the benevolent saint Nikola who the name is derived from, symbolizing the virtues of love, kindness, and selflessness. Ultimately, Nikoletta is a name that inspires the bearer to strive for success and victory in spiritual as well as secular matters.
